queue.topic: Forum map for civil and commercial disputes in Kolkata: Calcutta High Court original side versus appellate side, pecuniary and territorial jurisdiction, the Commercial Division and Commercial Courts Act 2015 in West Bengal, pre-institution mediation under Section 12A, City Civil Court and district courts, arbitration seat in Kolkata, execution of decrees. Do not repeat the existing Noida commercial-courts article; link it for comparison.

Industrial and commercial plots in Noida and Greater Noida for businesses and investors: allotment and lease from NOIDA, GNIDA and YEIDA, lease deed terms, permission to mortgage and sublet, transfer and change of use, default and cancellation, remedies before the authority, High Court writ and civil court. Confirm current authority policies from official notices; leave out any figure that cannot be confirmed. Link the existing Noida real-estate and recovery articles.

Commercial premises leases in Kolkata and Noida: registration and stamp duty differences between West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh, lock-in and escalation, security deposit, unregistered leases and Section 107 Transfer of Property Act, eviction routes, arrears recovery, sub-letting, rent-law coverage. Link the existing UP/Delhi tenant guide; do not repeat it.

Municipal and building-law remedies in Kolkata: Kolkata Municipal Corporation building plan sanction, unauthorised construction and demolition notices, hearing and appeal under the Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act 1980, Municipal Building Tribunal, writ jurisdiction of the Calcutta High Court against municipal action, neighbours' remedies and typical timelines. State only what can be confirmed from the Act and reported decisions.

Arbitration practice in Kolkata: Section 9 interim relief, Section 11 appointment and Section 34 challenge in the Calcutta High Court, commercial division handling, deposit and stay of awards, execution, institutional and ad hoc arbitration with a Kolkata seat. Do not repeat the existing Noida and Delhi seat article; link it.

Litigating in India as an NRI or against a defendant abroad: service of summons on parties abroad (Order 5 CPC, Hague Service route and letters rogatory), evidence on commission, video-conference hearings, appearing through a power of attorney holder and its limits, security for costs, limitation. Link the existing NRI power-of-attorney article; do not repeat it.

Enforcing Indian court decrees and money judgments in the UK, the USA and Canada: reciprocating territory status, registration routes, common-law enforcement, what Indian decree holders need to prepare, limits. Confirm the position from statutes and reported decisions. Do not repeat the existing article on enforcing foreign decrees in India.

Child custody and cross-border parental disputes involving India and the USA, Canada or the UK: India is not a party to the Hague Child Abduction Convention, welfare principle, habeas corpus in the High Court and Supreme Court, mirror orders, foreign custody orders in Indian courts, travel and passport issues. Link the existing divorce and custody article; do not repeat it.

OCI, citizenship and renunciation: effect of acquiring foreign citizenship on Indian passport, surrender certificate, OCI rights and limits, effect on bank accounts, agricultural land, inheritance and voting; the legal position under the Citizenship Act 1955. Link the existing OCI property guide; do not repeat it.

EPF, PPF, gratuity and pension for NRIs and those leaving India: withdrawal rules, inoperative accounts, PPF on change of residency, taxation of interest, transfer abroad, claims by legal heirs. State only what can be confirmed from the schemes and statutes.

Non-compete, confidentiality, notice period and garden leave in Indian employment contracts: Section 27 Contract Act, enforceability during and after employment, injunctions, recovery of training bonds, notice-pay disputes, reported decisions.

Workplace sexual harassment law for employers: POSH Act 2013, Internal Committee composition, inquiry procedure, timelines, annual report, penalties for non-compliance, employer duties for smaller workplaces and the Local Committee. Educational compliance explainer only.

Gift deeds, release deeds and family settlements: stamp duty and registration pitfalls, differences between West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh practice, when an unregistered family settlement is valid, challenges and limitation. Link the existing guide on revoking gift deeds; do not repeat it.

Specific performance and injunctions after the 2018 amendment to the Specific Relief Act: mandatory specific performance, readiness and willingness, time as essence, liquidated damages and Section 74 Contract Act, interim injunctions, substituted performance. Link the existing news and title articles; do not repeat them.

Civil and commercial litigation in Delhi: Delhi High Court original side, current pecuniary jurisdiction as notified, commercial division and district commercial courts, Section 12A pre-institution mediation, summary suits under Order 37, execution. Link the existing Noida commercial-courts article; do not repeat it.

DDA and L&DO leasehold property in Delhi: lease terms, conversion to freehold as currently notified, mutation, permission to sell, misuse and unearned increase, disputes before the Delhi High Court. Confirm current policy from official notices; leave out any figure that cannot be confirmed.

The Delhi Rent Control Act 1958: coverage and the rent threshold, grounds of eviction under Section 14, bona fide requirement, Section 25B summary procedure, revision to the High Court, premises outside the Act and the Transfer of Property Act route. Link the existing Delhi and UP tenant guide; do not repeat it.

Unauthorised construction, sealing and demolition in Delhi: Delhi Municipal Corporation Act 1957 stages, MCD notices, Appellate Tribunal MCD, DDA and Master Plan issues, writs in the Delhi High Court, regularisation and compounding, buyer and neighbour perspectives.

Where to sue in Delhi NCR: territorial jurisdiction when parties or property are in Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram or Faridabad, CPC Sections 16 to 20, contractual jurisdiction clauses, commercial courts, arbitration seat, cheque cases, interim relief across State lines. Link the existing Noida and arbitration seat articles; do not repeat them.
